oneOf.description: ev 'machine' (step 32): sent on connect and on every change — state = one of the 17 PackML states (studio/src/shared/packml.ts), mode = Auto | Manual | Maintenance. Commands: cmd op start | hold | stop | reset, and op mode with 'mode'; a refusal is res ok false, err STATE | MODE, msg = the reason. ev 'alarms' (step 33): on connect, list = the active alarms [{ code, text, priority 1-4, time hh:mm:ss, acked, active }]; ev 'alarm': act raise { code, text, priority, time } | ack { code, time, by } | clear { code, time } — an alarm leaves the list when acked and cleared (studio/src/shared/alarms.ts). Command: cmd op ack { code, user }, refused with err ALARM. Step 34: cmd op download { rt } (program.rt.json as an object; only in STOPPED, else err STATE; the runtime checks schema → err SCHEMA and the CRC → err CRC) → res { ok, crc }; evt 'machine' also carries prog = CRC of the loaded program (null = none); ev 'step' { flow, pc } on every step change (flow = flow id, pc = step index; the studio finds the node by rt.flows[flow].steps[pc].src); state frames: v = values by tag id, pc = step per flow id.
